characters.name: Lin Wei
characters.description: A disowned sword-student of the Crane Sect, carrying the tally-stick her dying master cut for the peace moot.
characters.motivation: To honour her master's last order and see the peace moot held.
characters.goal: Deliver the tally-stick to the three named sects before midsummer.
characters.flaw: Shame makes her hide her disowning, even from allies.
characters.internal_conflict: She believes she failed her master, though she kept every vow.
characters.external_conflict: The Eel School calls her tally void because she is disowned.

abilities.name: Reed-step
abilities.description: Runs across reeds and rigging by the light-body art, in keeping with the covenant's limits.

characters.arc: Lin Wei stops hiding her disowning and lets the tally speak for itself.

characters.name: Gao Ren
characters.description: Senior brother of the Eel School, a hard pragmatist whose school has gone hungry under the nesting ban.
characters.motivation: To win the rookery fishing rights his school needs to survive.
characters.goal: Discredit the tally-stick and void the moot.
characters.internal_conflict: He respects the covenant he is trying to bend.
characters.external_conflict: Lin Wei's tally, if honoured, calls a moot that could codify the ban forever.

abilities.name: Eel-form grip
abilities.description: A wrestling style that turns an opponent's balance against them on wet ground.

characters.arc: Gao Ren must decide whether a lawful loss is worth more than a starving victory.

characters.name: Mei Sura
characters.description: A Salt Warden clerk on Saltmarket Isle who registers challenges and keeps the market's envoys' book.
characters.motivation: To keep Saltmarket neutral and the moot lawful.
characters.goal: See the moot convened on her isle, under the market peace.
characters.flaw: She hedges every promise until the cost of honesty is clear.
characters.internal_conflict: Her neutrality protects the market but starves her of conviction.
characters.external_conflict: Both sects pressure her to mislay or hasten filings.

abilities.name: Covenant recall
abilities.description: Recites the pact and its precedents from memory, word for word.

characters.arc: Mei Sura finally stakes her neutrality on the side of the tally.

relationships.description: Gao Ren challenged Lin Wei's right to carry the tally.
relationships.conflict: Each believes the other's sect is breaking the covenant.

relationships.description: Mei Sura registers Lin Wei's tally over Eel School objections.
